# DbVisualizer

> > DbVisualizer is a universal database management tool with SQL Commander, GUI features, and support for multiple database platforms.

DbVisualizer offers both free and Pro versions for database administration, query development, and visual database exploration. The site provides comprehensive documentation, troubleshooting guides, and educational content for database professionals working with SQL tools and JDBC connectivity.

## Key Topics

- DbVisualizer
- DbVisualizer Pro
- SQL
- SQL Commander
- Database Management
- JDBC Drivers
- Database Client
- User Guide
- Documentation
- GUI Features
- Result Sets
- SQL Tools
- Troubleshooting
- MySQL Indexing
- Database Connectivity

## Getting Started

- [Evaluate DbVisualizer DB Tool](https://dbvis.com/eval): 21-day Pro trial evaluation for DbVisualizer database tool
- [DbVisualizer User Guide 26.1](https://dbvis.com/docs/ug): DbVisualizer 26.1 user guide covering database management and SQL features
- [DbVisualizer User Guide 26.1 (Confluence)](https://confluence.dbvis.com): Complete DbVisualizer 26.1 user guide with SQL tools and GUI features docs

## Documentation & User Guides

- [Comparing SQL Scripts in DbVisualizer](https://confluence.dbvis.com/display/UG120/Comparing+SQL+Scripts): SQL Commander script comparison guide for DbVisualizer Pro users

## Support & Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting in DbVisualizer](https://confluence.dbvis.com/display/UG130/Troubleshooting): DbVisualizer troubleshooting guide for JDBC driver and connectivity issues
- [Customer Portal Login](https://portal.dbvis.com): Customer portal login for DbVisualizer Pro purchase and account access

## Educational Content

- [MySQL Indexing Mistakes 101](https://dbvis.com/thetable/mysql-indexing-mistakes-101): MySQL indexing mistakes guide by Lukas Vileikis with optimization tips
